integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from the published ADDIS-Spending state update. Numerical checks are supplementary. The classical sinh product is used only for the inverse-square specialization.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for independent Uniform(0,1) complete-null p-values, fixed thresholds, and rejection levels contained in the candidate region; it does not cover conservative nonuniform nulls, dependence, alternatives, ADDIS-Graph, or exhaustive ADDIS.
title: Exact complete-null FWER law for ADDIS-Spending
